symbolic.annotation: write to GITHUB_ENV may allow code execution

concrete.feature:
run: |
          range=$(node -p "require('./package.json').peerDependencies.electron")
          version=$(npm view "electron@$range" version --json | node -e \
            "const v=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));console.log(Array.isArray(v)?v.at(-1):v)")
          if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Invalid Electron version from registry"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Electron $version (peer range $range)"
          echo "META_SOVEREIGN_ELECTRON_VERSION=$version" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
